'''Imperial Survey 1982376''' was part of [[Moff Sarne's forces]] during the [[DarkStryder Campaign]]. They were assigned the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] [[Blade (shuttle)|''Blade'']].

{{Imp-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Imperial Survey 1982376 may not exist; it is clear during the adventure, [[Showdown (The Kathol Rift)|''Showdown'']], that the transmission from the team is a faked [[Distress signal/Legends|distress signal]] to draw the ''[[FarStar]]'' into an [[Skirmish on Demonsgate|ambush]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Demonsgate]].
